scope: 13 assigned TCG panoramas; current tracked masters and localized promotion derivatives
method: Viewed each of 39 original source file instances with view_image, then each complete localized panorama and all nine 750x1050 physical crops individually. Compared source identity/form, visible face, limbs, digits, markings, silhouette, containment and scene boundaries. Recomputed SHA-256 for every source and tracked artwork and matched against provenance. Existing passed flags were not treated as anatomy evidence. File hashes were verified after the visual inspection; no source or artwork file was changed.
limitations: Joint-scene stylization and pose variation are allowed; no pixel equality requirement was imposed.
Uncertain denotes insufficient feature-level visual evidence and is not approval.
Derivative hashes identify exactly the viewed files; this report does not independently reproduce localization/slicing or validate PDF contents.
Tiny details were not assigned an invented canonical count when the source/crop did not support one.

subjects.observations: Two head projections, paired eyes, chest form, purple abdomen and a single curved tail remain recognizable. Raised hand retains three round tips. The grounded left foot collapses the reference's elongated split toes into several round lobes; the lower foot/ankle structure is deformed. All limbs fit r3c1; grass approaches but does not hide the foot defect.

Two triangular ears, red eyes, dorsal bulb, three large visible legs and green patches remain. The generated chest has a sharply outlined cream/tan bib, whereas the source chest is green. Near front and rear claws are softened; small source leg markings are also simplified. Entire bulb and paws fit the cell.

Orange body, blue eyes, cream belly, two arms, two legs and one flame-tipped tail remain. Reference has three discrete white pointed claws on each foot; output substitutes flesh-colored flat fingerlike toes. The arms are serrated rather than clearly articulated; mouth teeth are weakly resolved. Tail and flame remain inside the cell.
